open_points.subject: surface request canonicalization for duplicate-key JSON
open_points.text: "module:surface turns every JSON text a request carries ... into its canonical form with canonical_values.canonical_bytes before any module sees it; a text JCS cannot represent is invalid_request" and canonical_bytes refuses "a duplicate key".
open_points.question: How must surface parse incoming JSON so duplicate object keys are detectable and refused, rather than silently collapsed by a normal JSON parser?
options: Require a duplicate-key-preserving JSON parser at the MCP boundary and refuse any duplicate key before canonicalization.
Use a standard parser (last-key-wins) and accept that duplicate-key refusal is unenforceable at the boundary.
Require JSON-text fields to be carried as raw strings and parsed by canonical_values with duplicate-key detection.
open_points.default_guess: Use a parser/path that preserves duplicate keys and refuse duplicates before canonicalization.

open_points.subject: store.record_change acting Actor handling
open_points.text: "public_op:store.record_change" input includes "the acting Actor" while "Writes exactly the records its change lists" and many written models have no actor field (for example NodeExecution M23, EffectAttempt M26).
open_points.question: What is the required behavior for the acting Actor when the target records do not have actor fields: persist it somewhere, or drop it?
options: Persist actor in hidden per-change metadata/addressable audit records tied to store position.
Use actor only when the target model has actor fields; otherwise do not persist it.
Require callers to embed actor into every payload record even where State 1 model has no such field.
open_points.default_guess: Use actor only where target records have actor fields; otherwise it is not persisted.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances service iteration scope
open_points.text: "refused naming the first failing service, services taken in service_id code-point order and each one's manifest record read in its turn".
open_points.question: Which services are included in this ordered check set at startup?
options: All services named in installation configuration.
Only services with a selected instance.
Only services that have both selected instance and credential configured for invocation.
open_points.default_guess: Check services that are configured for invocation (selected instance/credential entries), in service_id order.
